system.name: SAE on Dora-VAE latents (feature decomposition pipeline)
system.one_liner: Applies a sparse autoencoder to the latent vectors of the Dora-VAE 3D reconstruction model to isolate, visualise, ablate and add single features.

content.variant_note: Dora-VAE encoder and decoder drawn with their internals around a latent bottleneck, an SAE column spliced into the bottleneck, and the SAE feeding two framed result galleries
content.argues: An SAE tapped into the VAE's latent vectors can isolate single features whose presence can be plotted on 3D shapes and whose ablation or addition changes the reconstruction.
content.subject: Dora-VAE encoder and decoder around a latent bottleneck, a sparse-autoencoder column with tensor shapes, and two galleries of 3D renders.

evidence: Dora-VAE is a 3D reconstruction model, encoding 3D objects to M latent vectors each.
We apply our SAE to these latent vectors, decomposing each vector to a linear combination of features.
modifying the latent vector and observing the effects on the reconstruction (Section 3.2)

summary: This paper applies sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to 3D representations for the first time, analysing the latent vectors of the Dora-VAE reconstruction model on Objaverse objects. Figure 1 shows the feature decomposition pipeline from left to right. A lilac Dora-VAE column draws the encoder and decoder internals in pale strokes, with a bold Latent Vectors box (M x 64) at the bottleneck. A teal SAE column maps those latents to feature vectors (M x 512), isolates one feature (M x 1) and decodes it into latent modifiers (M x 64) that return to the decoder. Two framed galleries show the outcomes: a 2 x 2 grid of point-cloud renders with red dots where a feature is present (Section 3.1) and three reconstructions after ablating or adding features (Section 3.2).
summary_zh: 论文首次把稀疏自编码器（SAE）用于 3D 表示，分析 Dora-VAE 潜向量。图 1 从左到右：淡紫色 Dora-VAE、青色 SAE 列（M×64→512→1→64），以及特征分布（3.1）、特征消融与添加后重建（3.2）两组结果。
notes: No body paragraph mentions the figure, so roles come from the caption, the abstract and the drawing. The meaning of the red dots and of the blue-green colouring of the renders, and which SAE box feeds the first gallery, are read from the picture only. The prior pass's contribution-mosaic is dropped because the galleries are outputs of one pipeline, not separate contributions; stage-pipeline (fan-out) is added because the SAE feeds two analyses.
